name: io.github.rotbolt.flakerandroidokhttp.ui.FlakerActivity
description: The Flaker (Rotbolt) OkHttp network-simulator app opens this screen from its launcher icon. It shows captured requests and lets the user switch simulation on or off, change settings, and search request history.
disableEffect: The network-simulation controls and captured-request history will no longer be available from the app's main screen.
